Place your local product images here.

Supported formats:
- .jpg
- .jpeg
- .png
- .webp
- .avif

Examples:
- clinique-moisture-set.jpg
- rare-beauty-soft-pinch-blush.png
- kerastase-nutritive-mask.webp

Then run:
- npm run products:sync

Or simply restart the frontend dev server:
- npm run dev

The generator will scan this folder and rebuild:
- src/data/products.generated.js

You can customize names, prices, badges, and categories in:
- src/data/products.js
